cohort: 113 singleton children born after ART and 113 naturally conceived controls
finding: This study found that ART was associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal and child outcomes, including maternal pregnancy complications, adverse birth outcomes, and neurodevelopmental disorders in children.
mod_finding: ART was associated with a higher likelihood of cesarean section (OR=2.3).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in the ART group (OR=3.2)
